## v0.5.12 · DSH RC and Alpha Compatibility

[#263](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/263) fixes [#261](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/issues/261): the turn memory bar and save action now register correctly on DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2 while retaining 0.1.5-rc.2 compatibility. Sidebar and Settings use the public main-session binding; explicitly scoped views keep their own session and workspace authority.

### Packages and upgrade

Only **dsh-mnemon 0.5.12** is newly published. The sixteen companion plugins retain their versions. No configuration or stored-memory migration is required.

The Client now requires **DSH 0.1.5-rc.1 or the supported newer cohorts**: the declared range is `^0.1.5-rc.1 || ^0.1.6-alpha.2`, with RC2 and alpha.2 explicitly verified. Older hosts without the public UI Session service must keep their previously verified Mnemon release.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.12
```

Restart DSH and reload the browser; use `headless` for that Profile. Mnemon CLI remains independently maintained.

### 中文说明

本版修复 DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2 中回合记忆条和“存入记忆”入口无法挂载的问题，同时兼容已验证的 0.1.5-rc.2。Sidebar 与设置页使用公开主会话 binding，Builtin 等显式范围界面保留各自会话和工作区权限。仅发布主包 0.5.12，十六个配套插件不变，无需迁移数据。Client 兼容下限为 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1；缺少公开 UI Session 服务的旧宿主应继续使用此前验证过的 Mnemon 版本。升级后重启 DSH 并刷新浏览器。

The implementation passed 1,183 root tests, actual Mnemon CLI checks, real RC2/alpha.2 WebUI operations and independent plugin composition. The [before/after evidence](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.12/docs/pr-assets/issue-261-dsh-slots/README.md) includes peer-plugin coexistence, workspace isolation and original screenshots. Models use an explicit loopback fixture; tools, storage and browser operations are real. The release workflow rechecks versioned artifacts, full Registry composition and an actual v0.4.7 upgrade before creating this Release.

See [English release notes](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.12/docs/en/releases/v0.5.12.md) and [中文发布说明](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.12/docs/zh-CN/releases/v0.5.12.md).
